tasks.short: Deliver the route on foot or by vehicle.

steps.what: List the specified route and its stops
Deliver mail to residences and business establishments
Keep walking or driving the specified routes
Use satchels, carts, and small trucks
Sign the delivery note
File the signed delivery note
outputs: filed copy of signed delivery note v1

tasks.design: A job in {OPS_SYSTEM} lists the specified route. The carrier delivers the mail to residences and business establishments, walking or driving, with satchels, carts, and small trucks. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. The route list does not walk the round, and it does not score the carrier.
tasks.previous_blocker: The route was learned by riding with another carrier.
tasks.enabler_now: Stop identifier and route name are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Walking and driving stay with the carrier.
tasks.human_edge: The carrier decides a stop was delivered.
tasks.altitude: The carrier spends the week on the route, not on listing stops.

reach.task: Receive only the mail the carrier delivers

evidence.claim: Walking, driving, sorting by hand, and handing mail to a person stay with the carrier. A stored list does not do that work.
Digest [S14] says documents, customs, and routing touch no Annex III area, and scheduling staff by behaviour or traits is high-risk. This design does not schedule or score the carrier.
Digest [S15] says those duties apply from 2 December 2027.

assumptions: Stop identifier and route name are stored on the route record. The route record produces them. A blank route name is not a round. The list does not schedule the carrier by behaviour.
Native configuration of the route record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the carrier signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the carrier delivering mail to residences and business establishments.

incremental.description: Refresh stop identifier and route name when the route layout changes, and drop a note the carrier has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many route names are blank. The high end assumes stop identifier and route name are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: List stored collection and return schedules
Meet schedules for the collection of mail
Meet the schedule for the return of mail
Sign the schedule note
File the signed schedule note
outputs: filed copy of signed schedule note v1

tasks.design: A job in {CALENDAR} lists the stored collection and return times. The carrier still meets those schedules. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. The list does not change working times and does not score the carrier.
tasks.previous_blocker: Collection times were pinned to a board.
tasks.enabler_now: Collection time and return time are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Being there on time stays with the carrier.
tasks.human_edge: The carrier decides the collection is done.
tasks.altitude: The carrier spends the week meeting the clock, not on listing times.

reach.task: Expect only the time the carrier signed against

evidence.claim: Walking, driving, sorting by hand, and handing mail to a person stay with the carrier. A stored list does not do that work.
Digest [S14] says documents, customs, and routing touch no Annex III area, and scheduling staff by behaviour or traits is high-risk. This design does not schedule or score the carrier.
Digest [S15] says those duties apply from 2 December 2027.
Digest [S17] says scheduling rules on working times need consent, as do tools that log who did what. This design does not change working times and does not add a score of the carrier.

assumptions: Collection time and return time are stored on the schedule record. The schedule record produces them. A blank time is not a schedule that has been met. The job does not change working times.
Native configuration of the schedule record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the carrier signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the carrier meeting schedules for the collection of mail.

incremental.description: Refresh collection time and return time when the schedule layout changes, and drop a note the carrier has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many collection times are blank. The high end assumes collection time and return time are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Sign for registered mail before leaving.

steps.what: List cash-on-delivery and registered items
Sign for cash-on-delivery and registered mail
Do that before leaving the post office
Sign the departure note
File the signed departure note
outputs: filed copy of signed departure note v1

tasks.design: A job in {OPS_SYSTEM} lists cash-on-delivery and registered items. The carrier signs for that mail before leaving the post office. A later job files the signed departure note in {DOCS}. The job does not sign for the carrier.
tasks.previous_blocker: The signature book was checked by turning pages.
tasks.enabler_now: Item identifier and service type are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The signature stays with the carrier.
tasks.human_edge: The carrier decides the item can leave the office.
tasks.altitude: The carrier spends the week on the signature, not on listing items.

reach.task: Release only the item the carrier signed for

evidence.claim: Walking, driving, sorting by hand, and handing mail to a person stay with the carrier. A stored list does not do that work.

assumptions: Item identifier and service type are stored on the item record. The item record produces them. A blank service type is not signed for. Filing the note does not create the carrier's signature.
Native configuration of the item record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the carrier signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the carrier signing for cash-on-delivery and registered mail.

incremental.description: Refresh item identifier and service type when the item layout changes, and drop a note the carrier has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many service types are blank. The high end assumes item identifier and service type are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Hold mail for customers who are away.

steps.what: List customers marked away and their locations
Hold mail for customers who are away
Decide the hold for each delivery location
Sign the hold instruction
File only the signed hold instruction
outputs: filed copy of signed hold instruction v1

tasks.design: A job in {OPS_SYSTEM} lists customers only when the stored away flag is set. The carrier holds the mail and decides the hold for each delivery location. A later job files only the signed instruction in {DOCS}. A blank flag is not a hold.
tasks.previous_blocker: Holds were a stack of cards with no flag.
tasks.enabler_now: Customer identifier, away flag, and delivery location are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Holding the mail stays with the carrier.
tasks.human_edge: The carrier decides the hold starts.

ambition.what: Sign the hold the day the stored away flag is set.

tasks.altitude: The carrier spends the week on the hold, not on listing flags.

reach.task: Have mail held only on the instruction the carrier signed

evidence.claim: Walking, driving, sorting by hand, and handing mail to a person stay with the carrier. A stored list does not do that work.

assumptions: Customer identifier, away flag, and delivery location are stored on the hold record. The hold record produces them. A customer is away only when the stored away flag is set. A blank flag is not a hold. The job does not redirect unsigned mail.
Native configuration of the hold record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the carrier signed is filed or sent.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining count is still the carrier holding mail for customers who are away.

incremental.description: Refresh customer identifier, away flag, and delivery location when the hold layout changes, and drop an instruction the carrier has not signed.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many away flags are blank. The high end assumes customer identifier, away flag, and delivery location are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The carrier spends the week on the route, with the mail, and on the signed note. A stored list and filing that signature can move. The carrier still walks, sorts, collects, and signs.
reach: A patron receives only the mail the carrier delivered.
A publisher receives only the form the carrier signed.
skills_to_grow: Reject a redirect the carrier has not signed.
Reject a receipt when the label does not match.
Reject a charge that treats a blank amount as zero.
role.ambitious_version: A signed hold or address change can be filed the same day, and the carrier still walks the route.
